summary: ITER.87 — 6 Correctifs UI validés. Tous les tests backend (12/12) et frontend passent. Splash screen vidéo fonctionne, Terminal mobile responsive, CVL Brain desktop layout correct, Inbox DMs bulles stylisées, Photo de profil avatar 80px cliquable, Splash depuis vitrine via dropdown utilisateur.

details: Splash screen appears on /pro route with data-testid='splash-screen'
Video files accessible: /videos/splash.mp4 (1075316 bytes), /videos/splash.webm (554781 bytes)
No 'OMEGA PROTOCOL' text visible
Fallback logo animation works when video doesn't autoplay (Playwright restriction)
Brain sidebar hidden by default on mobile (<768px)
Brain toggle button opens fullscreen overlay on mobile
Monaco editor takes full width on mobile
data-testid='terminal-brain-mobile' overlay works correctly
Sidebar 280px fixed on left (hidden lg:flex)
Conversation zone flex:1 min-w-0 in center
'1 JCC par requete' text visible in gold at footer
Split panel (CODE PREVIEW) visible on desktop
Received messages: white 5% background (rgba(255,255,255,0.05))
Sent messages: gold background (#f2ca50)
Timestamps visible with proper styling
Inbox notification badge gold on OrbitalMenu (data-testid='inbox-unread-badge')
Avatar 80x80px clickable with gold initials
POST /api/user/avatar endpoint exists (returns 401 without auth)
Endpoint rejects invalid formats (returns 400)
data-testid='avatar-clickable' present in SovereignProfileView
Espace Pro link in user dropdown menu (header)
Clicking Espace Pro from vitrine shows splash screen
ProSplashWrapper component resets splashDone on route change
/sounds/notif.mp3 accessible (18028 bytes)
/sounds/notif.ogg accessible (24078 bytes)
useNotificationSound hook properly loads and plays sounds
